verdict.rationale: CSC tracks good standing and filing deadlines through its Compliance Calendar and Corporate Tracker, and its entity management platform claims bi-directional integrations via modern APIs. However, no evidence shows those APIs expose standing or deadline data, and documented alerting is email-only, with no public OpenAPI spec found. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for good standing and filing deadline data, registrable webhooks for status or deadline events, public API documentation or spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse

citations.quote: Enable secure bi-directional integrations with enterprise and third-party systems via modern APIs
You receive a report that outlines upcoming filings 45 days in advance, along with the good standing status of each entity that has a filing due in this window
